title: Atom
description: An atomic structure consists of a nucleus and electrons. Its atomic number identifies its chemical element.

title: Atomic nucleus
description: The central structure of an atom.

title: Electron
description: A negatively charged elementary particle.

title: Proton
description: A positively charged constituent of an atomic nucleus. Its count gives the atomic number.

title: Neutron
description: An electrically neutral constituent of most atomic nuclei.

title: Photon
description: A quantum of the electromagnetic field.

title: Quark
description: A kind of elementary particle that makes up protons and neutrons.

title: Water
description: A molecular compound. Here it also connects to the irrigation cartridge and to water as a classical element.

title: Air
description: A mixture of gases. Its composition may vary with moisture, altitude, and local conditions.

title: Soil
description: A mixture that can include mineral particles, organic matter, water, air, and organisms.

title: Rock
description: A naturally occurring solid material composed of one or more minerals or similar substances.

title: Glass
description: A noncrystalline solid material.

title: Alloy
description: A metallic material that contains more than one chemical element.

title: Molecule
description: A bonded group of atoms.

title: Light
description: Electromagnetic radiation. Visible light is the part of the spectrum people can see.

title: Sound
description: A mechanical disturbance that propagates through a medium.

title: Gravity
description: Gravitational interaction, explored in the orbital mechanics and force field cartridges.

title: Magnetism
description: A family of electromagnetic phenomena. Tabor World uses magnetic snapping as a separate interface behavior.

title: Fire
description: Combustion can produce heat and light. Fire also has a distinct place in classical cosmologies.

title: Vacuum
description: A region with very little matter.

title: Time
description: The order and duration of events. In the engine it also controls simulation and timing challenges.

title: Solid
description: Matter with a characteristic shape and volume under ordinary conditions.

title: Liquid
description: Matter that flows and generally retains its volume while taking the shape of its container.

title: Gas
description: Matter that expands to fill the space available to it.

title: Plasma
description: Ionized matter with mobile charged particles.

title: Earth
description: Classical and symbolic use of earth. See the Worlds Atlas for Earth as a planet.

title: Water
description: Classical and symbolic use of water.

title: Air
description: Classical and symbolic use of air.

title: Fire
description: Classical and symbolic use of fire.

title: Space / aether
description: A concept appearing in several classical traditions with different meanings.

title: 1+1=2 · BUILD
description: Nathan Tabor’s BUILD anchor. Add two distinct records to the comparison tray.

title: 1−1=0 · CLEAR
description: Nathan Tabor’s CLEAR anchor. Remove a record from the comparison tray or clear the tray.

title: Universal Bridge
description: The existing Tabor engine connects bottom-screen progress to charge, buffs, shield, and top-screen scoring.

title: Pinch-to-Move
description: The shared input path for two-contact positioning, scale, and twist.

title: Hook
description: The receiving target in Hook & Ring.

title: Ring
description: The swinging prop in Hook & Ring.

title: 16-node rope
description: The fixed-step visual rope shared with Grapple It.

title: Tabor Track Baller
description: Nathan Tabor’s touchscreen controller for rolling, swirling, strokes, pinch, twist, and tilt.

title: SANTA KRAMPUS
description: One of Nathan Tabor’s TWINS of MAS.

title: SANTA SUPMARK
description: One of Nathan Tabor’s TWINS of MAS.

title: SANTA GLAMPUS
description: One of Nathan Tabor’s TWINS of SPIRIT.

title: SANTA SUPMALS
description: One of Nathan Tabor’s TWINS of SPIRIT.

title: MAS SPIRIT
description: Nathan Tabor’s TWINS of MAS and TWINS of SPIRIT, together.

title: BIBLeTopia
description: Nathan Tabor’s village- and town-building world with game and story connections.

title: Grapple It
description: Nathan Tabor’s game world with rope and trajectory play.

title: Organism
description: A living individual in an ecosystem.

title: Cell
description: A basic structural and functional unit of living organisms.

title: Plant
description: A group of organisms represented in Tabor World through growth, soil, water, and canopy interactions.

title: Animal
description: A group of living organisms represented in the agriculture, forestry, and animal care branch.

title: Ecosystem
description: Organisms and their physical environment considered together.

title: Habitat
description: The environment in which a given organism lives.

title: Absence
description: A missing object or record in a defined context. The interface displays missing connections as a catalog state.

title: Number
description: A way to express count, amount, position, or value, including the atomic-number index.

title: Pattern
description: A recurring arrangement or behavior that can be inspected across cartridges and catalog records.

title: Wave
description: A propagating disturbance. The v.7 wave pool lets the user compare one source and two.
